sections.title: Join Cost Model — Inside the Planner's Brain

blocks.md: Planner cost = startup + run. seq_page_cost=1.0, random_page_cost=4.0, cpu_tuple_cost=0.01. Hash Join cost = build + probe. Merge Join = sort + merge. Understanding cost model = predicting plans.

blocks.label: cost parameters
blocks.code:
-- View cost parameters
SHOW seq_page_cost;      -- 1.0 (sequential I/O)
SHOW random_page_cost;  -- 4.0 (random I/O)
SHOW cpu_tuple_cost;    -- 0.01 (per tuple CPU)
SHOW cpu_operator_cost; -- 0.0025 (per operator)
SHOW parallel_tuple_cost; -- 0.1

-- Override for session
SET random_page_cost = 2.0;  -- SSD: random cheaper
SET seq_page_cost = 1.0;

-- Hash Join cost = build_cost + probe_cost
-- build = seq_scan_build + cpu_hash * rows
-- probe = seq_scan_probe + cpu_hash * rows

sections.title: Dynamic Programming & GEQO — Join Ordering at Scale

blocks.md: PostgreSQL uses Dynamic Programming for join ordering up to `join_collapse_limit` (default 8) or `from_collapse_limit` (default 8). DP considers all left-deep trees. Complexity O(3^N) — exponential but manageable for N ≤ 12.

blocks.label: dp vs geqo
blocks.code:
-- DP join ordering (default for ≤ 12 joins)
SET join_collapse_limit = 8;  -- default
SET from_collapse_limit = 8;

-- GEQO (Genetic Query Optimizer) for > 12 joins
SET geqo_threshold = 12;  -- default
SET geqo = on;            -- default
SET geqo_effort = 5;      -- 1-10, higher = more search

-- Force GEQO off
SET geqo = off;
SET join_collapse_limit = 20;  -- extend DP
blocks.pg:
-- DP: exhaustive for small N, guaranteed optimal
-- GEQO: genetic algorithm, probabilistic, for large N
blocks.mysql:
-- MySQL: no DP/GEQO distinction
-- Optimizer uses greedy search + dynamic programming (limited)

blocks.md: DP guarantees optimal for small N. GEQO is probabilistic — may find different plans on re-plan. For reproducible plans with large N: increase geqo_threshold or use pg_hint_plan.

items.explain: DP considers all subsets and partitions. O(3^N) for left-deep trees.
geqo_threshold (default 12) controls switch from DP to genetic algorithm.

revisionCard: Cost model: seq_page_cost=1, random_page_cost=4, cpu_tuple_cost=0.01 — tune for hardware
DP ordering (N≤12): exhaustive DP, optimal. GEQO (N>12): genetic, probabilistic
Parallel Hash Join: workers build independent hashes; Gather Merge for ordered output
work_mem critical for Hash Join: spill = Lossy bitmap → massive slowdown
Unique inner optimization: planner stops after first match on PK/FK inner
Right-deep trees: Hash Join can build on right (smaller build side)
